component.name: Kin Galeri
component.summary: Fast local photo & video library for Linux

description.p: Kin Galeri is a local-first photo and video library for the Linux desktop, built with Qt 6, Qt Quick and C++20.

It indexes folders on disk into a searchable catalog with EXIF metadata and a thumbnail cache, so browsing a large collection stays fast. Photos and videos are never modified unless you explicitly ask; removing something sends it to a recycle bin inside the library.

ul.li: Recursive folder indexing with selectable ignore rules
Timeline grid, full-screen viewer and playback via libmpv
Full-text search over file names, albums and camera metadata
Manual and source-based albums, favourites and soft-delete recycle bin
Light/dark themes, six accent colours and English/Indonesian UI
No account, no server and no mandatory network access

description.p: First public release: indexing, thumbnails, timeline grid, viewer, video playback, albums, recycle bin, search and settings.
